# Prodory

> Prodory is the cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes and platform engineering practice of AO Plus Solutions Pvt Ltd, based in Dombivli, Maharashtra, India. It serves BFSI, SaaS and global capability centres in India.

Services:
- Kubernetes platforms: production clusters on bare metal, VMs, EKS, AKS and GKE. https://prodory.com/services/kubernetes-platforms/
- VMware to OpenShift and KubeVirt migration, in waves with rollback. https://prodory.com/services/vmware-to-openshift-migration/
- Sovereign and hybrid private cloud, mapped to DPDP and CERT-In obligations. https://prodory.com/services/sovereign-hybrid-cloud/
- Infrastructure automation and GitOps with Terraform, OpenTofu, Ansible and Argo CD. https://prodory.com/services/infrastructure-automation-iac/
- Cloud and Kubernetes cost optimisation, delivered as pull requests. https://prodory.com/services/cloud-finops-cost-optimization/

Principles: all infrastructure code lives in repositories the client owns; changes go through reviewed pull requests; handover includes runbooks.
